context: Two friends commiserate about a terrible day commuting and writer’s block
purpose: Teach: 通勤/反論/高める/最悪/さあ/執筆/男の子/悪化

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: さあ、今日もやっと終わったよ。通勤じゃないけど、満員電車で大学まで行くのが本当にしんどい。
lines.en: Phew, finally done for today. It's not technically a commute, but riding the packed train to uni is really brutal.
lines.style: Ren sighs, slumping into the cafe seat with visible exhaustion.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: わかる。俺なんて朝、隣にいた男の子がずっと泣いててさ、もう最悪な気分だったよ。
lines.en: I get it. This morning a little boy next to me was crying the whole ride — I was already in the worst mood.
lines.style: Riku complains casually, rolling his eyes with teenage exaggeration.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: それは災難だね。しかも雨で電車が遅れて、状況がどんどん悪化していくパターンでしょ?
lines.en: That sounds rough. And with the rain delaying trains, things just keep getting worse, right?
lines.style: Ren responds with sympathetic understanding, nodding knowingly at the shared misery.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: まさにそれ。で、レポートの執筆も全然進まなくて、もう書ける気がしない。
lines.en: Exactly that. And on top of it, my report writing isn't progressing at all — I don't feel capable of writing anymore.
lines.style: Riku groans dramatically, hands covering his face in frustration.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: わかるよ。俺も論文書いてるけど、文章の質を高めるどころか、一行も進まない日があるんだよね。
lines.en: I feel you. I'm working on my thesis too, but some days, forget about improving the quality — I can't even write a single line.
lines.style: Ren laughs ruefully, sharing the same writer's block struggle.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 先生に「もっと考えろ」って言われても、反論できないし、ただ落ち込むだけ。
lines.en: When the teacher tells me to think harder, I can't even argue back — I just end up feeling down.
lines.style: Riku speaks in a defeated teen tone, slouching in his chair.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 今日はもう諦めて、美味しいもの食べて寝ようよ。明日また頑張ればいいって。
lines.en: Let's just give up for today, eat something good, and sleep. We can try again tomorrow.
lines.style: Ren offers gentle encouragement with a warm, older-sibling tone.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: そうだね、それが正解かも。さあ、ラーメンでも食いに行こうぜ!
lines.en: Yeah, that's probably the right answer. Come on, let's go grab some ramen!
lines.style: Riku perks up suddenly, energy returning with the prospect of food.
